home.seoTitle: What is GDG on Campus Trakya?
home.seoP1: Google Developer Groups on Campus is the name Google gives to developer communities at universities. GDG on Campus Trakya University (gdgoncampustu) is the programme's community at Trakya University, run by students.
home.seoP2: We hold workshops, talks and hackathons on campus. Students from any department can join: you register for an event on this site, your QR ticket appears on your profile, and you show it at the door.
